name: Elise
source:
Member of the Berlin Combat Revue

Captain of the Berlin Combat Revue. Accomplishes any mission, no matter how difficult, with her steely resolve, level-headed approach, and excellent leadership skills. Her special attack move is called Stahl Krone. Born into an aristocratic family with strong military ties, she received a very strict upbringing and firmly believes that actions speak louder than words. She's interested in Japanese culture and enjoys watching kabuki plays and reading haiku poetry. Tasked with demanding missions every day, she has begun to mutter in her sleep due to a buildup of stress and fatigue.

[i]"No, we're not here as your 'backup.' We defeated the demons ourselves."[/i]

[From [url=https://games.sega.com/sakurawars/lang/en/]SEGA[/url]]
